shared_elements: animate figures with heads and facial features
justification: The only real overlap is the very generic presence of animate beings or heads with facial features; A shows two frontal anthropomorphic heads joined in a bust-like form, while B shows a field of schematic profile animals and signs arranged in horizontal bands. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a paired frontal human/anthropomorphic figure, whereas B is an organized relief composition of multiple animals, birds or symbols with no comparable twin-headed figure or central face-to-face scheme.
